dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Tom, are Bangkok and London very different?
dialogue.reading: ˈtɑːm, ər ˈbæŋkɑːk ənd ˈlʌndən ˈvɛri ˈdɪfərənt?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Not very. They're both big and busy, and both cities have great food.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈvɛri. ðɛr ˈboʊθ ˈbɪɡ ənd ˈbɪzi, ənd ˈboʊθ ˈsɪtiz ˈhæv ˈɡreɪt ˈfuːd.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Neither of them is cheap. But London is much more expensive.
dialogue.reading: ˈniːðər əv ðɛm ɪz ˈtʃiːp. bʌt ˈlʌndən ɪz ˈmʌtʃ ˈmɔːr ɪkˈspɛnsɪv.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Both cities have trains and buses, so you can go almost anywhere.
dialogue.reading: ˈboʊθ ˈsɪtiz ˈhæv ˈtreɪnz ənd ˈbʌsɪz, soʊ juː kən ˈɡoʊ ˈɔːlmoʊst ˈɛniwɛr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And the sidewalks? In Bangkok, they're often narrow and crowded.
dialogue.reading: ənd ðə ˈsaɪdwɔːks? ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk, ðɛr ˈɔːfən ˈnæroʊ ənd ˈkraʊdɪd.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: In London, they're wider. But London is far colder!
dialogue.reading: ɪn ˈlʌndən, ðɛr ˈwaɪdər. bʌt ˈlʌndən ɪz ˈfɑːr ˈkoʊldər!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: So where do you want to live in the future?
dialogue.reading: soʊ ˈwɛr duː juː ˈwɑːnt tə ˈlɪv ɪn ðə ˈfjuːtʃər?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I don't know. I'm happy in either city!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈnoʊ. aɪm ˈhæpi ɪn ˈiːðər ˈsɪti!
